title: Pending-feature registry
description: Features the FEA docs describe at full strength that are not yet in the current release. Docs flag them with [not yet in the current release](pending:<id>) or a ```fea pending=<id> fence; `runmat check` diagnostics carry the same id.

id.description: Stable dotted key shared by docs, diagnostics and the agent.

title.description: What the feature does, in the docs' final-state wording.

acceptance.description: What must be true for landed_in to be set.

witness.description: Commands or tests that prove the feature once it lands.

gaps.description: Engineering-queue and audit ids (GAPS.md G-*, LANG-*, PHY-*, MOD-*, register rows).

decision.description: Present when the owner has not yet confirmed the feature belongs in the final system.

doc_less.description: Reason an open entry is referenced by no doc page.

landed_in.description: Release that ships it; null while pending.
